use default
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math.log10

let random = System.Random(2026)

let rounds = 10000

let staying = LIST[double]()
let switching = LIST[double]()

let stay_wins mut = 0
let switch_wins mut = 0

for trial in 1::rounds do
    let car = random.next(3)
    let chosen = random.next(3)

    let opened mut = random.next(3)

    while opened == chosen \/ opened == car do
        opened = random.next(3)
    od

    let switched = 3 - chosen - opened

    if chosen == car then
        stay_wins = stay_wins + 1
    fi

    if switched == car then
        switch_wins = switch_wins + 1
    fi

    staying.add(cast double(stay_wins) / cast double(trial))
    switching.add(cast double(switch_wins) / cast double(trial))
od

curve(rates: List[double]) -> List[(x: double, y: double)] =>
    rates
        |> index()
        |> map(rate =>
            (x = log10(cast double(rate.index + 1)), y = rate.value))
        |> collect_list()

let stay_colour = (red = 210ub, green = 130ub, blue = 40ub)
let switch_colour = (red = 40ub, green = 85ub, blue = 165ub)

let image = IMAGE(760, 460)

image.colour(95ub, 100ub, 115ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.x_title = "games played"
axes.y_title = "win rate"

axes.x_ticks(
    (0::4)
        |> map(decade =>
            (value = cast double(decade),
             label = "{System.Math.pow(10.0, cast double(decade))}"))
        |> collect_list())

axes.y_ticks([
    (value = 0.0, label = "0"),
    (value = 1.0 / 3.0, label = "1/3"),
    (value = 0.5, label = "1/2"),
    (value = 2.0 / 3.0, label = "2/3"),
    (value = 1.0, label = "1")
])

axes.key("switching", switch_colour)
axes.key("staying", stay_colour)

axes.fit(0.0, 0.0, 4.0, 1.0)
axes.draw()

image.colour(195ub, 200ub, 210ub)

for line in [1.0 / 3.0, 2.0 / 3.0] do
    image.line(0.0, line, 4.0, line)
od

image.stroke(1.4)

image.colour(stay_colour)
image.line(curve(staying))

image.colour(switch_colour)
image.line(curve(switching))

image.write("monty-hall.png")

image.show("monty-hall.png")
